title: Adversarial review result record
summary: JSON Schema for one review answer: target hash, status (untested/observed-pass/observed-fail/blocked/not-applicable), finding type, scope and hashed evidence with method, locator, coverage, limits.
description: This is the owner's authoritative adversarial review bank: the 1,024 questions of Appendix E of the Animation and Video Production Master Guide (10 Oct 2026), transcribed with the owner's exact text, ids, filters and pass membership. Another builder in this catalogue (harness_kit) independently wrote a different 1,024-question bank; it is not this set and does not override it. The record shape is the guide's own example (included verbatim as an example); evidence items carry the fields the guide requires of real evidence.
evidence_notes: Valid and invalid examples behave as labelled under jsonschema Draft 2020-12. The guide's own untested record is an example verbatim; the other valid examples are illustrative with synthetic hashes. Not yet used to record a review of a real film through this package.
